name: Toxic Seal
description: At the end of the User's Turn they are inflicted with the Badly Poisoned Status Ailment. This ignores Type Immunities. If they lose this item, the Badly Poisoned Status fades. As long as they are holding this item, they may reset the Badly Poisoned damage back to 1 as a Bonus Action on their turn. In addition, they gain +1 Base Dexterity.
